hooks.command: [ -z "$BLACKHOLE_PLUGIN_ROOT" ] || exit 0; r=; if [ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] && [ -n "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" ]; then r=$(printf %s "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" | sed "s/'/'\\\\''/g"); fi; if [ -n "$r" ]; then printf "\nexport BLACKHOLE_PLUGIN_ROOT='%s'\n" "$r" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; else echo "blackhole: cannot export BLACKHOLE_PLUGIN_ROOT (CLAUDE_ENV_FILE or CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT unset); scripts will not resolve" >&2; fi; exit 0
